ic.definition: All acceptance criteria of Jira ANA-42 (ASADA-UI-01 AC01-AC10 and ASADA-UI-02 AC01-AC08) are implemented on apps/dashboard and each AC has at least one automated test, in apps/dashboard/e2e/asada.spec.ts (fake Jira / fake Social boundaries, production build) for the UI criteria, supported by apps/dashboard/e2e/social.spec.ts (cockpit states incl. the live-source label), e2e/contrast.spec.ts (pixel-measured contrast), e2e/quality.spec.ts (axe), apps/dashboard/src/features/social/state.test.ts (state reconciliation) and apps/dashboard/src/server/access.test.ts (access boundary); the rendered home and channel picker are compared against the refinement package SOLL A (home) and SOLL B (channel picker), sha256 7d8e577c520dd8b5b14eae0cc0012b3c6b5449bf1eb813b738e96c90bbd10211, with the recorded overrides (no 'ANA SAVU DASHBOARD' subtitle, route /pulse/social/instagram, DE subtitle 'Waehle einen Kanal'). UI01-AC01 / shows exactly one H1 'ASADA', no subtitle, no focus sentence, no 'Current Focus' and no Reality/Choose/Act/Close stages; document title contains ASADA; URL stays ana.dyai.cloud. UI01-AC02 tile order Social Media Business, Initiatives & Progress, Sessions & Workshops, Knowledge & Resources, Community & Relationships as one uniform column. UI01-AC03 Social Media Business is visible without scrolling at 1440x900, 1280x800 and 1024x768, carries the largest and boldest tile title, Inter, card width about 620 px and base height about 116 px growing with text zoom. UI01-AC04 the other tiles read Under Construction, are dimmed (not via opacity), have no link, button, tabindex, role or number. UI01-AC05 the Instagram state on the tile is derived from the real Social API answer (cockpitStateOf); STALE, ERROR, PERMISSION_REQUIRED and EMPTY never render as Live or Connected; the home shows the less reassuring of the cockpit's last report and its own read unless its read carries a newer snapshot (homeState), so a failed refresh is never masked by the server cache and a recovered worker is never masked by an old failure. UI01-AC06 glass remains the primary material (translucent tile background, blur, 1 px edge, 28 px radius, specular) with brushed aluminium only on the glyph tiles; no flat white standard cards (tile background is never an opaque white); light canvas rgb(236,239,243) with dark ink; rail, topbar, icons and language switch kept and recognizable; no theme switcher. UI01-AC07 /pulse/social/instagram works unchanged on the light material and shows the live-source label; the metric logic is untouched and no analytics are faked: the diff against the base changes nothing under apps/dashboard/src/features/social/insights.ts, format.ts or apps/dashboard/src/server/social/. UI01-AC08 WCAG AA contrast measured on rendered pixels (contrast.spec.ts), solid 2 px focus ring, accessible names, DE/EN/IT, viewports 1440x900, 1280x800, 1024x768, 390x844, 200 percent zoom without clipping, prefers-reduced-motion without animation. UI01-AC09 Cloudflare Access and the server-side JWT / e-mail check are unchanged (the diff against the base changes nothing under apps/dashboard/src/server/access* or the middleware) and unauthorized requests return no app data (access unit tests; live P01 proves an anonymous request is turned away); in addition the Social API refuses cross-site reads, the browser never calls the worker and the bundle holds no worker key (scan:bundle). UI01-AC10 with the worker in ERROR, PERMISSION_REQUIRED, hang or EMPTY the home stays understandable and never fakes an active substitute; the cockpit's own live-source label says 'live' only while CONNECTED and names EMPTY, STALE and failures as such. UI02-AC01 click, Enter or Space on the tile opens a glass dialog titled Social Media Business; the home remains visible behind it and is measurably dimmed (every tile except the trigger faded and blurred). UI02-AC02 channels Instagram, Substack, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook in this order; only Instagram is a link, to /pulse/social/instagram. UI02-AC03 the other four rows read Under Construction, are plain list items with no link, button, tabindex, role or number. UI02-AC04 two interactions from home to the cockpit; browser back returns to ASADA with no dialog. UI02-AC05 initial focus on the Instagram row, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside, Escape, X and backdrop click close and return focus to the tile; at 390x844 the dialog stays inside the viewport without horizontal overflow. UI02-AC06 the Instagram row carries the adapter state chip for CONNECTED, LOADING, EMPTY, STALE, ERROR and PERMISSION_REQUIRED; the note says 'live cockpit' only while CONNECTED and otherwise names the real state in EN/DE/IT. UI02-AC07 silver material, Inter, contrast and DE/EN/IT reuse the existing system; the ANA-19 modal lifecycle (focus trap, Escape, focus return) is reused. UI02-AC08 the real Instagram cockpit and the HTTPS / Access boundary are unchanged after the release: after the picker the cockpit still reads Instagram only through /api/social/instagram, never the worker; the diff changes neither the Instagram adapter, the Social API route contract nor the access layer; live P01 and P11 re-prove the boundary on production. Live counterpart: apps/dashboard/e2e-live/asada.live.spec.ts P01-P11 against https://ana.dyai.cloud (fail-closed preconditions), run only after the production release.

r2g.definition: On the exact candidate SHA: (1) GitHub Actions workflow 'dashboard' green: npm ci, lint, typecheck, vitest, production build, client bundle secret scan, Playwright e2e against the fake Jira and fake Social worker boundaries (evidence_class integration-fake). (2) GitHub Actions workflow 'dashboard-image' green for the SHA (release bundle artifact ana-dashboard-<sha>). (3) GitHub Actions workflow 'drs' green: the pinned DRS v1.0 validator over .drs/*.json with the PR head SHA. (4) Client bundle scan of apps/dashboard/.next/static finds 0 occurrences of the Jira token, the Social worker key value, the SOCIAL_IG_* variable names, a Bearer or Basic authorization header and the worker internal path. (5) The local full Playwright suite on the exact SHA is green, including e2e/asada.spec.ts, contrast.spec.ts and quality.spec.ts (axe). (6) Screenshots from synthetic fixtures of the home, the DE home, the channel picker and the cockpit at 1440x900, 1280x800, 1024x768 and 390x844 are available for an independent SOLL A / SOLL B comparison in the private evidence folder (never committed). (7) The diff against the base contains no secret, no Access session cookie, no G2/G3 Instagram data (no real caption, media id, permalink, thumbnail or metric value) and no change to the Cloudflare Access / server-side JWT boundary, the Instagram adapter or the Social API route contract. Stale evidence (a run on another SHA) is not evidence; a new commit invalidates R2G.

r4m.definition: The unchanged R2G candidate has: one independent acceptor (ROLE: DRS REVIEWER for ANA-42 in a separate session, or the PO) that verified the IC and R2G evidence on the exact candidate SHA (the implementing session and its subagents or workflows never accept their own candidate); 0 open BLOCKS_CURRENT_GATE findings and every PR review thread resolved; PR #15 mergeable with base at most 1 commit behind main; PR CI ('dashboard', 'dashboard-image', 'drs') green on the exact SHA; a PRE_MERGE reconcile of Jira ANA-42, Confluence 07 section 2.1, Design Schema section 2.1, 04 and 08 and GitHub without critical drift; the rollback target a0f60f5245a0ca2d3a51046bc4ae315970df0399 recorded. MERGED is not Production Verified: the Jira Definition of Done (release on Contabo via release.sh, live Playwright matrix on https://ana.dyai.cloud with a legitimate Access session, screenshots against SOLL A/B) closes the item, not this gate.
